mentions.name: Echelon headless bike conversion device
mentions.description: A hardware device that converts headless Echelon exercise bikes (and possibly rowers) into fully featured bikes, letting them work without using Echelon's app. The builder is offering beta testing units to interested users.
mentions.problem: Headless Echelon exercise bikes are limited to the company's predatory app and lack full functionality on their own.
mentions.audience: Owners of headless Echelon exercise bikes (and rowers)
mentions.source_excerpt: I am building a device that turns the headless Echelon exercise bikes (and rowers?) into fully featured bikes without using their predatory app.

evidence.value: I am building a device that turns the headless Echelon exercise bikes (and rowers?) into fully featured bikes without using their predatory app.
